MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The locking nut assortment fits my recent interest in fastening supplies for repair projects, provided the sizes match the bolts I need to secure.",
    "Recommending fasteners reflects part of my intent: I have repeatedly looked at nails, screws, and wall anchors for construction and mounting tasks."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The finish nails look related to my framing nails, but they serve a different purpose and need compatible equipment; matching the length alone does not make them useful to me.",
    "The cutting wheels and flap discs assume I need to cut or grind materials, while my recent choices center on fastening them.",
    "The pump, shaft collars, pressure gauge, heat shrink tubing, seal tape, and kerosene can require specific jobs I have not shown a need to do."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in construction fasteners seems to have been stretched into an interest in workshop and repair supplies generally.",
    "Shared words such as nails or matching dimensions seem to count too much when the actual application and equipment requirements differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated framing-nail choices include specific collation angles, shank dimensions, and head styles; those compatibility details matter when choosing more nails.",
    "The screws and anchors suggest practical fastening and mounting needs, rather than an immediate need for unrelated machinery or electrical repair parts.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags were separate household needs; they do not mean I am currently shopping for every kind of maintenance supply."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in fastening supplies but extended it too broadly to repair equipment without enough evidence of a matching job or compatible tools."
}
